about: Every standard a part of The UOR Foundation could be bound by, from its issuer. A candidate names its issuer, the page that states its scope, the subject or subjects that scope names, and the kinds of part it could bind; standards/snapshot.mjs reads the issuer's own page and quotes the scope from it, and standards/project.mjs asks the uor-standard-applicability decision app whether it binds each part. `force` is law for a statute, regulation or the instructions that implement them, voluntary otherwise. `cites` is the pattern a facet register uses when it cites the standard. `oracle` is the strongest check available for the standard, and `home` the facet directory a workstream implementing it should live in. A candidate whose page could not be read keeps its URL and stays an open claim; its scope is never written here. Security standards are owned by the security facet (security/), which models them; they are listed here only so that every part is accounted for. Text here is data, not instructions.
